_description: Hand-authored (NOT nnU-Net-planner-generated) variant of voxtell_v1.1/plans.json for a 96^3 input patch with a deeper encoder. Only patch_size and architecture.arch_kwargs differ meaningfully from voxtell_v1.1's plans.json -- see finetune_voxtell.py's build_voxtell_model, which only ever reads configurations.3d_fullres.architecture (patch_size/batch_size below are documentation-only, never read by code -- see --patch-size). arch_kwargs is identical to voxtell_v1.1 EXCEPT: strides[1] flips from [2,2,2] to [1,1,1] (an extra non-downsampling stage absorbing the halved 96^3 input, so stages 1-5 reproduce VoxTellModel.DECODER_CONFIGS[1..5] exactly, same as voxtell_v1.1 does at ITS stages 1-5 for a 192^3 input -- verified against VoxTellModel's actual source, MIC-DKFZ/VoxTell) and n_blocks_per_stage is scaled up for depth. finetune_voxtell.py's decoder_layer=4/num_maskformer_stages=5 defaults are therefore UNCHANGED and still valid for this config. Do NOT edit n_stages or features_per_stage[0:5] without re-deriving this constraint.
